name: Miso Robotics (Flippy)
oneLiner: Maker of Flippy, a robotic fry station, and Zippy, an AI operations dashboard for restaurants built on its 2026 acquisition of Zignyl.
bestFor: High-volume QSR and venue kitchens (including stadiums) willing to pilot robotic frying, and operators who want an AI operations dashboard.

updates.text: Acquired Zignyl, an AI restaurant operations and employee incentives app, and folded it into Zippy, a conversational operations dashboard that also shows Flippy ROI, live video and maintenance data.
Shipped Flippy to its first NBA arena, its first stadium deployment, marking an expansion into arenas and live-event venues.

features: Flippy Fry Station: robotic arm that loads, fries, shakes and dumps baskets
Computer vision to identify food and track cook times
Handles dozens of fried menu items such as fries, onion rings and chicken
Designed to fit existing fry lines with limited construction
Zippy AI dashboard: ask operational questions in plain language
Employee incentive and performance tracking (from Zignyl)

pricing.text: No published price; Flippy is offered on a robotics-as-a-service subscription with quotes on request.

notes: Fortune (Feb 2026) reported Miso had 14 Flippy units in the field (White Castle and Insert Coin), about $385K net revenue in 2024, and ended partnerships with CaliBurger and Panera. The footprint is small, so position Flippy as an emerging or pilot-stage option. Jack in the Box ran Flippy (20 locations reported in June 2025) but current status is unconfirmed, so it was left out. Dropped from the current review: QDOBA, Cinnabon, Scooter's Coffee (no source found); Jersey Mike's and Jamba are customers of Zignyl/Zippy software, not Flippy. Website link in the current review had a utm_source=chatgpt.com tag; use the clean URL. Also reported: April 2026 support partnership with AwesomeOS and acquisition of Zume Pizza's patent portfolio (no confirmed source URL/date captured). Miso's own site claims Flippy has passed 5M baskets (vendor claim).
